title: The axes got lost; the base axis structure (2026-10-25)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
Ok. Looks like something got lost here.  I've spent a lot of time on the axes. 


Lots issues. 

Then, let's see if we can restore  axes and poles. 


The base axis structure is:

Line 1:
Act / observe
Do the work/ update how workngets done

Line 2: 
Disrupt/ stabilise 
Bring in new things/ make what we have better 

Line 3: 
Focus/zoom out 
Drive the agenda from our plan/ or synchronise and adjust based on the context
